documents.a: A CV and a scan of a valid passport. Diplomas and certificates help. Cruise jobs also need STCW training, a seaman's book and a medical certificate.

time.q: How long does the process take?
time.a: It depends on the employer and the country. After an offer, a work permit and a visa usually take several weeks to a few months.

status.q: How do I follow my application?
status.a: In your account. You also receive an email each time the status of your application changes.

reapply.q: Can I apply again to the same job?
reapply.a: You can apply to the same job once every 6 months. You can apply to other jobs at any time.

data.q: What happens to my personal data?
data.a: It is used only for your applications. You can download or delete your data from your account at any time.

who.title: Who is responsible for your data
who.text:
IconBridge Recruitment Ltd ("IconBridge", "we") runs this site and decides how the personal data collected here is used: it is the data controller.
For any question or request about your data, write to contact@iconbridgerecruitment.com.

what.title: What we collect
what.text:
Your account: email address, password (stored only as an irreversible hash), language.
Your profile: name, gender, date of birth, nationality, country and city of residence, phone and WhatsApp numbers, passport details (number, issuing country, dates; the number is stored encrypted), profession, experience, education, languages, driving licence and, for cruise ships, sea experience and maritime certificates.
The documents you upload (CV, passport scan, diplomas, certificates…) and your applications: cover letter, answers to the job's questions, a copy of your profile at the time of applying, and the progress of each application with the messages we send you.
Job alerts: the email address and the destinations and job types you chose. Contact form: your name, email address, phone number, message and the IP address it came from.
Security: the IP address and browser of your signed-in sessions, and a record of sensitive actions in the back office.

why.title: Why we use it, and on what legal basis
why.text:
To create and run your account, handle your applications, present your profile to the employer of each job you apply to and prepare your work permit and visa files: this is needed to provide the service you ask for (contract).
To send job alerts, which you confirm by email and can stop with one click, and to publish a success story, only with a signed consent document: your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
To keep the records and documents that immigration and employment rules require: legal obligation.
To protect the site and your account (anti-robot check, limits on attempts, security records): our legitimate interest in keeping the service safe.
We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising.

share.title: Who receives it
share.text:
Our recruiters, and our agent in your country of nationality, who only sees the candidates of that nationality.
The employer of each job you apply to, and the authorities that process work permits and visas.
Technical providers acting on our instructions: Microsoft Azure (hosting, database, file storage, sending of emails and technical monitoring) and Cloudflare (domain name, the anti-robot check of the forms, and forwarding of emails sent to our addresses).

partners.title: People put forward to our partner companies
partners.text:
Some employers we work with ("partner companies") put forward candidates themselves, in a private workspace we provide to each of them (a "partner space"). There, the partner company and the members of our team it works with record, for each person: first and last name, nationality, optionally a phone number and an email address, the follow-up of the visa (status, appointment and decision dates) and of the documents sent by courier (dates, tracking number), the passport, CV and work permit, and comments.
We use these data to follow the work permit and visa of each person with the partner company, on the basis of the contract with that company and our legitimate interest in placing the people it puts forward, and to keep the records that immigration rules require.
Only the members of that partner space see them: the accounts of the partner company and the members of our team added to it. They are never shown on this site, never mixed with candidate accounts, and nothing is ever emailed to the people concerned. They are stored with the rest of the site, in the European Union, the files in a private storage space opened only through links valid for 5 minutes, and every change and every file opened is recorded.
They are kept until the application or the partner space is deleted; a deleted application leaves only a line saying that it was deleted, without any name. To access, correct or delete these data, write to contact@iconbridgerecruitment.com: we delete an application with all its files and comments on request.
The accounts of partner companies hold an email address, a name shown to the other members, a hashed password and a language; their emails (password reset only) are sent in that language. The partner area remembers the language you chose with a cookie.

transfers.title: Where your data is stored
transfers.text:
The site, its database and your documents are hosted by Microsoft Azure in the European Union (Italy); emails are sent from Azure's European data location.
Cloudflare may process technical data (IP address, browser details) outside the European Union, under the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. When you apply to a job with an employer outside the European Union, for example a cruise line, your application is shared with that employer for that purpose.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.text:
A candidate account with no activity for 24 months (no sign-in, no application sent or moved forward) and no application in progress is deleted with all its documents. We email you 30 days before; signing in is enough to keep the account.
You can delete your account yourself at any time from your account settings: your files, then your data, are erased at once.
Contact form messages are deleted 24 months after they were received. Records of sent emails are kept 30 days, technical logs 30 days, and a signed-in session lasts at most 7 days. When an address is reported undeliverable (it bounced), we keep only a fingerprint of it, so that no more emails go to it, for 24 months after the last report.
Deleted data disappears from our backups within about five weeks (database backups 7 days, weekly copies 30 days plus 7 days in the recycle bin). A published success story stays online until you withdraw your consent.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text:
You can access, correct and download your data, and delete your account, from your account. You can also ask us to restrict or stop a use of your data, object to it, or withdraw a consent you gave, by writing to contact@iconbridgerecruitment.com. We answer within one month.
You can also complain to a data protection authority, in particular the one of the country where you live or work.

security.title: How we protect it
security.text: Passwords are hashed and passport numbers encrypted; lists show a masked number, and the full number is shown only to the people handling your file. Your documents are stored in a private storage space and opened only through links valid for 5 minutes. Each member of our team only sees what their role allows, and sensitive actions are recorded.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: The site only uses the cookies needed to sign you in, and remembers your language and colour theme. The anti-robot check of the forms (Cloudflare Turnstile) reads technical details of your browser for that purpose only. No advertising or audience-tracking cookie is used.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: We may update this policy; the date at the top shows the current version. Questions: contact@iconbridgerecruitment.com.
